bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives Anna a birth date of 18 Sep 1900 in Plymouth Twp, from a Pennsylvania births index ('Annia Pringle'). It shows her still single and living with her father, Addison F. Pringle, in Wilkes-Barre's 15th ward in 1930, and in the same house in 1935 and 1940 (S1). No marriage or death has been found.
